terminal.communityMission1.desc:
Station Zero, Manning analysis. From this point, it is worth starting a report on the systematic study of quasimorphosis. The important part: “No pathogens were isolated from the group. No bacteria, viruses, fungi, or higher parasites. I know for sure that hormonal imbalances are a consequence of their madness and not the cause. None of those interrogated could describe the reasons why they decided to join the cult. Even the organizers say that this idea just came to them. Some patients report whispers from another world. The phenomenon has no physical cause. But there is a physical effect. I propose that this phenomenon be called quasimorphosis.” Learn by heart.

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityMission2.desc:
Why don't we find living beings in phased buildings? Expedition Sector Louhi-XV: “Dr. Peabody has confirmed that Object 0-177C is a sarcophagus. Very similar to a Nahua sarcophagus. Moreover, Peabody insisted that it was sealed, as if the funeral rites had already been completed. But the sarcophagus is empty. Where should we look for quasimorphs?”

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityMission3.desc:
Eccolapse. That is the answer to my question. Hypothesis: phasing—the transition of inanimate objects from pleroma to kenoma; eccolapse—the transition of living objects from pleroma to kenoma. Does this mean that quasimorphs are in some sense "living objects"?

Dr. Eipschwitz.

Project Dislocator Note: If my theory of movement into the pleroma is correct, can I bring Tifton combatants back without eccolapse? It will be interesting to watch how the mercenaries get back into the kenoma through the bodies of people.

Addendum: talk to the authorities about buying prisoners in L-BSA.
terminal.communityMission4.desc:
Does the existence of phased sarcophagi mean that quasimorphs "die" in their bramfaturas? Maybe my hypothesis was wrong from the very beginning. It is necessary to immediately request from Peabody an array of hypotheses about the possible purpose of objects of Type 0-177C other than funeral ones.

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityMission5.desc:
The deciphering of Stone R-98-21 is progressing. The Knorozov tables still fit after transposition. Next comes an analytical review of the result. From what catches the eye, the Silver Orb is mentioned there. The cosmography of its location relative to Venus shows that it may be Earth.

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityMission6.desc:
The report has been sent to Fresco's board of directors. Now they will definitely finance my project on Mercury. However, I can't wait to see what the corporate intelligence officers bring back from Earth. I hope Interdict will not interfere, and the cargo will arrive on time.

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityMission7.desc:
I hope the archive ends up in good hands. I am removing the security levels available to me from Dr. Eipschwitz's personal journal. These... beings... are already appearing on the streets of Oddibjord-3. Better death than going through what happened to the guys... The last thing I can do is make the texts of this monster public. The communication channel with SBN is not working. The texts hang suspended in the terminals. I hope that sooner or later the one who will save humanity gets to them.

Archivist, Randall Baranov, Star-4 access.
terminal.communityMission8.desc:
Quasimorphs are not even energy, they are a completely new type of existence. I believe that by moving to Earth, they must have either acquired a body without eccolapse or somehow become attached to a material object. My research on the Dislocator already allows me to create a prototype of a quasimorphic detector. I think it won’t be a mistake if I propose to the management that they send a reconnaissance group to Mexico City or another altepetl.

Dr. Eipschwitz.
terminal.communityStone1.desc:
To the new king who received the kingdom from Tezctlan. The Orders transfer power to you until Tezctlan returns from his pilgrimage to the Silver Orb. You are bound by the oaths of the Jaguar, the Eagle, the Python, and the other free inhabitants of Gannix. We wait and believe that the hylonaut (a traveler to earth—footnote by Eipschwitz) will return and again take the Emerald Kingdom into his hands.

Before the Reaper of the Harvest, I, Marquis Decarabia, answer to the Orders and renounce the honor of waiting for Tezctlan on the obsidian throne. May Gannix live for an eon without a king. Free orders under the glow of the red-golden eye of Gagtungr.

No one has ever returned from the Silver Orb. We don't know how Tezctlan will be regained.
terminal.dislocatorMission1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>, I express my gratitude for your help in the <color=#FFFEC1>Inner System</color>. You carried out Operation Gilead brilliantly. Please, maintain control of <color=#FFFEC1>Flat Obsidian</color> for at least a little while longer. Sending data about the <color=#FFFEC1>Device</color> over the Network is prohibited. Send a courier. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission2.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, how can you be sure that this <color=#FFFEC1>AnCom</color> HIS isn’t just monitoring Venus for the purpose of reselling information, and is somehow exercising control over the Invasion ? Your theory from here, from the core of the System, looks even less reliable than from the rings of Saturn. <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission3.desc: The courier has arrived in <color=#FFFEC1>Rogue City</color>. I'm working with the data. I ask you to assist me on Mercury for at least a little more time. I look forward to your cooperation, <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission4.desc: Leave Mercury immediately and return to <color=#FFFEC1>Saturn</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color> has no authority to give you orders, <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>. We are aware of the <color=#FFFEC1>Device</color>. Deconstruct it immediately and take with you all the components that you consider significant for analysis. <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission5.desc: I've intercepted the message from the <color=#FFFEC1>Council</color>. Don't ask questions. <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>, I ask you to trust me. We will be able to use the <color=#FFFEC1>Dislocator</color> to fight the Regime. Stay on <color=#FFFEC1>Mercury</color>, I'll think of something soon. <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission6.desc: Say the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Word</color> and you will live forever under the banner of the green shine. If you refuse, I will send my slaves to you to extinguish your sick consciousness forever. <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission7.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Issachar</color>, you should make a decision as soon as possible. Quasimorphic distortions are occurring in the communication systems. In addition there are signs of an HIS without a corporate transponder heading for <color=#FFFEC1>Flat Obsidian</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>
terminal.dislocatorMission8.desc: If you do not immediately leave <color=#FFFEC1>Mercury</color> then the <color=#FFFEC1>Council</color> will raise the question of declaring you and <color=#FFFEC1>Comrade Issachar</color> renegades. Your help is objectively needed on <color=#FFFEC1>Saturn</color>. Stop testing the patience of the <color=#FFFEC1>Council</color>, <color=#FFFEC1>Gad</color>. <color=#FFFEC1>Leah</color>
terminal.dragonReborn1.desc: Report date 993008. The inability to take a sample from <color=#FFFEC1>the Monolith</color> forces us to work with it holistically. We are now testing the assumption that this is a <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorph</color>. Second hypothesis: the existence of a quasimorph on <color=#FFFEC1>Mars</color> means that there is still a <color=#FFFEC1>bramfatura</color> here, but it is much more hidden than the others. On the other hand, if all the quasimorphs of this bramfatura are as inert as the Monolith, then there may already be many of them around us, while we mistake them for the natural structures of Mars. <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.dragonReborn2.desc: Report date 991009. No radiography of the <color=#FFFEC1>Monolith</color> gives clear results. At this point, one thing can be said: the Monolith does not come from our world. Perhaps it was brought here from another planet after <color=#FFFEC1>phasing</color> there. Or <color=#FFFEC1>Mars</color> has a hidden <color=#FFFEC1>bramfatura</color>. Third hypothesis: Mars <color=#FFFEC1>had</color> a bramfatura, and the Monolith phased before it disappeared. Corollary: bramfaturas may disappear. Hypothesis to be tested: whether bramfaturas can occur. <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.dragonReborn3.desc: Report date 992109. A report for the management has been generated and submitted. There is no way to study the <color=#FFFEC1>Monolith</color> more than we already have. Perhaps it will remain a mystery to <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> for decades to come. <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.dragonReborn4.desc: Report date 991111. The device that was given to us allows us to gain a much deeper understanding of the nature of the Monolith. I'd like to know which corporation is so far advanced in quasimorphic research. RealWare has nothing like it. The data is already being compiled. <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.dragonReborn5.desc: Report date 991113. My hypothesis was correct. The <color=#FFFEC1>Monolith</color> is a <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorph</color>. At least, all the key metrics match the data that was provided to our team with the device. However, I have to decipher <color=#FFFEC1>what state</color> this quasimorph is in. What do these shifts to the left along the Q-spectrum mean? <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.dragonReborn6.desc: Report date 991225. Usually at Christmas people give gifts, but ours were taken away. Yesterday we handed over the device to security. Now all we have to do is process the data. Hypothesis four: can <color=#FFFEC1>quasimorphs</color> sleep. Hypothesis five: can quasimorphs <color=#FFFEC1>be dead</color> in a way that leaves bodies. Perhaps the Monolith is a dead quasimorph. <color=#FFFEC1>Dr. Dennett</color>
terminal.EmeraldTemple1.desc:
Instruction for the Acolyte, Section 4

The New Corporate Ethic (NCE) was forged as a neutral accord between the six Hexarchs. It binds together what remains of free humanity. The NCE walks the line between anarchy and order, a fragile balance born from the final fires of the Great Anarchist Revolution.

We were not invited to the table when the NCE was written. Matters of faith were left outside its scope. It speaks of "freedom of religion," as though the soul were private property—a commodity, not a sacred trust protected by corporate law. That is a grave mistake. The purity of the soul is a service, one the Church of Revelation provides in exchange for trust and dignitas.

The Hexarch Tianming maintains its own version of the NCE, known as the Mandate of Heaven. They are allowed what we are denied. And only because the Church is not a Hexarch—not one of the Six. Yet we must become one. We stand between faith and contract, between God and the bottom line.
terminal.EmeraldTemple2.desc:
Instruction for the Acolyte, Section 5

Each Hexarch left their own mark on the NCE. That's why the ancap system endures — it's not chaos, but equilibrium. Tianming codified the laws and language. Dilthey redefined freedom through the contract, stripped of the meaningless notion of "free will." AnCom gave anarchy its aesthetic and its heroic myth. RealWare justified the right to violence against public enemies and became the NCE's sword and shield. SBN bound the system with a network, made the NCE public, and granted it memory. It doesn't matter what the sixth Hexarch contributed.

What matters is that the Church of Revelation was excluded from authorship. And now the AnCap system tolerates heathens like the Sunlight Coven. They should have been declared public enemies long ago and hunted across the entire Solar System.
terminal.EmeraldTemple3.desc:
SBN Traffic Summary and Resolution. Access Level: Abbot

Following the events on Venus, spiritual security across the Solar System has collapsed. Our analysts report a 62% drop in the Spiritual Security Index. Mercenaries—and the Hexarchs behind them—have interfered in a sphere that does not answer to the market.

The Hexarchy has once again rejected the Church’s petition to include the Spiritual Security Index in the text of the NCE. They claim that faith is beyond regulation. Yet it is precisely for that reason that evil acts freely. Hell recognizes no contracts. Until spiritual risk is acknowledged as a legal fact, every soul remains undefended.

Effective immediately—without directly violating the Hexarchy’s embargo on Venus-related data—information about the growing spiritual instability in the System must be disseminated.
terminal.EmeraldTemple4.desc:
CHURCH OF REVELATION

The key to psychological survival is safeguarding the peace of your immortal soul. The Church of Revelation provides this service for you. Use our consecrated Spiritual Bonds—reliable neural inductors of inner tranquility. Obtain access to the Sacraments under the supervision of certified Church ministers.

Remember: unauthorized spiritual services offered by third-party corporations compromise your protection and open channels through which Absolute Evil may enter your soul. None of the six Hexarchs offer comparable standards of spiritual security.

THE CHURCH OF REVELATION: we safeguard not only your ritual, but your sanity.
terminal.EmeraldTemple5.desc:
Instruction for the Acolyte, Section 27

In the beginning of the universe, there was a catastrophe. The One Spirit was shattered into countless fragments and imprisoned within the stifling prison of matter. The history of the cosmos is the Spirit's long struggle to gather itself again—first through the birth of organic life, then the cell, then the multicellular, and so on.

At last, some tens of thousands of years ago, the Spirit achieved its greatest victory: humanity emerged. Humanity could believe in God directly and act as the Spirit's agent. Yet even within humankind, the battle for unity continues. The wars of ideologies, tribes, cultures, and aesthetics—all are obstacles to reunification.

Only one true faith can lift the universe out of the abyss of this ancient disaster. The Church of Revelation is the first organization that is the corporate agent of the Spirit. Others clutter human minds with noise. Some even lead people down false paths that end in evolutionary and spiritual dead ends.

This is why the Church supports some ideologies and opposes others. Anarcho-capitalism has come closer than any other system to understanding true freedom. Yet we must remember that our support depends on the vector of movement toward the Spirit, not on morality or any other human convention.
terminal.EmeraldTemple6.desc:
Theology of Quasimorphosis. Access Level: Abbot.

We call quasimorphosis a disease of matter, but in truth, it is the universe's reaction to the approach of truth. When an individual or a collective of people comes into contact with the limit of knowledge, the fabric of the world trembles. Forms appear that should not exist.
There are reports that research by AnCom and Fresco indicates that quasimorphosis is a technical problem. It is either a side effect of the material world's existence, or the material world is a side effect of the quasimorphs' existence.
The Church disagrees. Quasimorphosis is the spiritual response of a world accustomed to the captivity of suffocating matter to the approach of liberation. Every explosion, every surge of violence is a moment when the Spirit remembers that it is divided.
The Church must hasten the new birth of the Spirit, regardless of any circumstances, be they obstacles of human or quasimorphic nature.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame1.desc:
AnCom Archive. Protocol 1948.

667. A fragment of uranium, obtained from our agent in Los Alamos, was successfully delivered to the Order's facility. The experiment with the Rök runestone is scheduled for tomorrow.
668. When the runic pattern on the uranium was completed, the metal came to life. Instruments recorded the disappearance of energy from the Stone. Primary conclusion: hylonauts exist. Secondary conclusion: hylonauts can be relocated. Further research: the possibility of awakening and establishing contact.
771. The history of Earth's religions is the history of a prolonged incursion, not mythology.
774. Hypothesis regarding the origin of the hylonaut inside the Rök runestone: Flauros.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame2.desc:
AnCom Archive. Fresco Protocol.

2180, May. The Fresco Corporation is conducting excavations in Mesoamerica. The probable target is a sarcophagus containing a hylonaut of the taltnom type.
2180, October. Evidence suggests that Fresco's target is one of the high hierarchs of Gannix.
2181, February. Record the threat level from the Fresco Corporation as: MAXIMUM.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame3.desc:
AnCom Files. Manning’s Fourth Report.

Research by Dr. Dennett has shown that the Sumerian temple system cannot be explained purely in cultural terms. All priests acted as intermediaries between things. The system was dictated by things, not by people. Any manifestations of the cult are interfaces granting access to the vessels of the hylonauts. The hypothesis is confirmed. Hylonauts have from the very beginning served as the hidden framework of our culture. For thousands of years, they lived on Earth. Now they are sealed in stone, gold, and wood. They did not feed on ritual songs or the cries of victims themselves. Their energy source is gavvakh—the emanation released through suffering. It is also the lure. I request that the Inner Rite consider the possibility of bribing or abducting Dr. Eipschwitz. It appears that the Fresco Corporation has long been aware of gavvakh and has advanced further in its research.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame4.desc:
Inner Rite Archive. Session Protocol 102.

Minority Report of the Third Master. The renaming to AnCom is a disgrace: where the Great Name once stood, only corporate gloss and emptiness remain. The Order of Andreyev is not a corporation. We must not play by the rules of SBN or RealWare.
Resolution on the minority report: grant the Third Master access to the Hive plan.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame5.desc:
Inner Rite Files. Catechisms for Inquisitors.

Catechism IV: Everything outside of AnCom is a potential enemy. This especially applies to those who appear to be allies.
Catechism VII: Inquisitors do not believe in God or gods. Inquisitors believe in humanity.
Catechism XII: The path into the Inner Rite lies through self-sacrifice.
terminal.FromSparkToFlame6.desc:
AnCom Files. Manning’s Seventh Report.

Gentlemen, I would like to thank you for the documents obtained from the Fresco Corporation. Does this mean we are preparing for something? Of course, straight to the point. With a high degree of confidence, I can speak about the nature of quasimorphosis. We are not dealing with an embodied collective unconscious, as Dr. Dennett appears to believe. On the contrary, the bramfaturas and their inhabitants are the reason our culture and our emotions look exactly the way they do. Earth's mountain ranges are the result of prolonged influence from Olirna; forests and swamps are the resonance of Gannix, and so on.
But far more importantly: desires, fear, courage, and so forth—these, too, are consequences of the quasimorphic world's influence upon us.

terminal.splatterStatue.desc: To the hero of the Great Anarchist Revolution, Matt "Wildcutter," who fought in the battle for the Tifton space elevator and showed great heroism, allowing it to be destroyed. His courage and devotion to the cause of freedom are forever inscribed in the history of humankind.
